subject.title: [Feature] Pre-response enforcement hooks (hard gates) for mandatory tool-call / policy rules

question: What versioned core/plugin response-gate contract and default fail-closed semantics should OpenClaw support for final-answer delivery?
rationale: This changes a security-sensitive runtime boundary across final response delivery, plugin APIs, config/defaults, retry behavior, and audit semantics; automation cannot safely choose those product/security contracts.

options.title: Design a versioned responseGate API
options.body: Add a maintained core/plugin seam for mandatory tool ledgers, typed validators, fail-closed finalization, retries/fallbacks, and audit records, while leaving domain policy packs to plugins or ClawHub.

options.title: Narrow to existing hooks only
options.body: Declare before_tool_call, before_agent_finalize, and message_sending as the supported policy surfaces and close or split this issue to smaller hook reliability gaps.

options.title: Defer pending API proposal
options.body: Keep the issue open but block implementation until a maintainer-authored design resolves the config, SDK, audit, and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Design a versioned responseGate API
recommendation.body: Add a maintained core/plugin seam for mandatory tool ledgers, typed validators, fail-closed finalization, retries/fallbacks, and audit records, while leaving domain policy packs to plugins or ClawHub.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the closest current before_agent_finalize seam and has the strongest history across the affected plugin hook/API files.
